_doc: GitHub Actions budget for the regression (tools/ci/plan.js). month_cap = free minutes per billing cycle (private repo, Linux 1x); cycle starts on billing_day; until exclusive_until (inclusive, UTC date) every push runs the FULL sharded suite; after it 'spread' mode: a push runs only the tests its change reaches (smartreg plan), a FULL run only for releases ([full] in the commit message, version.json changed, or a manual run with mode=full), always within the daily allowance = (cap - used - reserve) / days left in the cycle; over the allowance → skipped (run locally). PUBLIC (his call 2026-10-12): the repo is public, standard Linux runners are free and unlimited → public:true turns the minute checks off (no skips); pushes still run smart, releases/manual full.
